name: vasantham-crm
description: Vasantham Tiles & Sanitary Wares — Customer CRM Workspace

scripts.dev: node scripts/update-ip.js && npm --prefix desktop run dev
scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/update-ip.js && npm --prefix desktop run dev
scripts.dev:browser: node scripts/update-ip.js && concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,DESKTOP" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/update-ip.js && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:tauri: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,TAURI" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev:tauri"
scripts.dev:all: node scripts/update-ip.js && concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,DESKTOP,MOBILE" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev:frontend" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/update-ip.js && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.build:exe: node scripts/update-ip.js && npm --prefix desktop run dist:exe
scripts.build:apk: node scripts/update-ip.js && npm --prefix mobile run build:apk
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
